major_cooldowns.name: Coordinated Assault
major_cooldowns.usage_rule: Use on cooldown for massive focus generation and pet/hunter damage synergy.

major_cooldowns.name: Spearhead
major_cooldowns.usage_rule: Use on cooldown to amplify your pet's damage and charge to the target.

major_cooldowns.name: Flanking Strike
major_cooldowns.usage_rule: Use on cooldown for a massive burst of Focus and strong immediate damage.

defensives.name: Aspect of the Turtle
defensives.usage_rule: Use to deflect all attacks and reduce damage by 30%, often used to immune mechanics.

defensives.name: Survival of the Fittest
defensives.usage_rule: Use proactively to reduce all damage taken by 30%.

defensives.name: Exhilaration
defensives.usage_rule: Use as a massive instant self-heal when dropping dangerously low.

rules.action: Use Raptor Strike / Mongoose Bite to spend Focus before it reaches 100%.
Cast Flanking Strike strictly within Spearhead or Coordinated Assault windows when possible to benefit from modifiers.
Ensure Serpent Sting is active on the primary target at all times.

source_summary: Survival Hunter is a rapid-paced melee/ranged hybrid that focuses heavily on Kill Command and Raptor Strike interactions. Burst is achieved by combining Coordinated Assault and Spearhead to massively amp pet and hunter damage.
